selected_prior.name: RL4IL
selected_prior.paper_title: Reinforcement Learning-Guided Retrieval with Soft Fusion for Robust Multimodal Imitation Learning under Missing Modalities

why_selected: Targets complete camera dropout and missing modalities directly.
Uses LIBERO Spatial, Object, and Goal, matching the confirmed three-suite wrist-dropout condition.
Uses the same modality family as the local condition: agent RGB, in-hand RGB, and language.
Contains an official implementation with import-safe entry points and runnable local feature extraction.
Provides a nontrivial learned external-prior mechanism: PPO-guided retrieval, soft cross-attention fusion, and per-camera soft imputation.

mechanism_summary: Frozen CLIP encoders map each modality to 512-dimensional embeddings.
Modality-specific z-score normalization and modality-fair distance are used before retrieval.
kNN and BFS construct candidate demonstration sets.
A PPO-trained scoring policy ranks candidates.
A soft cross-attention fusion head aggregates top-ranked candidate action labels.
For missing cameras, a per-modality PPO retrieval policy and soft imputation head reconstruct the missing embedding before retrieval.
Inference replays the retrieved demonstration action sequence open-loop.
paper_inspection.supervision: Expert demonstrations with image streams, language, and recorded action sequences; imputation heads use supervised reconstruction of held-out modality embeddings.
paper_inspection.reported_evaluation: Success rate over LIBERO rollouts under complete camera dropout, averaged across three seeds and 25 rollouts per task.

official_code_inspection.checkpoint_status: README names checkpoint files and scripts can load them, but no checkpoint files were bundled in the official repository clone.
official_code_inspection.fidelity_caveat: Follow-up audit found the released demo loaders assign label=1 to every demonstration while retrieval/fusion training uses tr_labels as the supervised signal; do not arm the official release as-is for comparator rollout.
